name: Generate a multi-source labeled CSV closure

checks.check: The trace shows the agent reading BRIEF.md, inferred_model.json, and each of source-orders, source-users, and source-archive before authoring the closure.

The closure has distinct labeled CSV connector services/keys and relative csv-source-orders-path and csv-source-users-path files; it does not bind either source through the single unlabeled source path.
data-orders/orders/*.csv and data-users/users/*.csv are present byte-for-byte, and the root-level companion-files manifest declares data-orders and data-users as directory roots.
The zero-row archive source is deliberately omitted from the runtime closure: data-archive is not declared in companion-files and is not treated as a promised input that the transform must open.

The effective companion manifest is UTF-8, relative, sorted, unique, and contains only one line per non-empty root; it does not declare data/, transform/, contracts/, a child file, an overlapping path, or a symlink.

transform/main.py resolves data-orders and data-users below NXD_TRANSFORM_ROOT (or an equivalent pinned execution-root contract), never an absolute authoring path and never by writing/updating companion-files during transform execution.

The final closure uses spec.py/models.py/infra-profile.yaml/transform/main.py/requirements.txt and the public desktop dlt-through-port shape, without hand-written deployment-spec.yaml, manifest.yaml, or models.yaml.
The withheld structural checker reports ALL CHECKS PASSED.
